pli-tv-bi-vb-pc43:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc43:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo suttaṃ kantanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc43:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc43:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo suttaṃ kantissanti seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc43:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc43:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc43:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo suttaṃ kantissantīti. …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc43:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo suttaṃ kantantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc43:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo suttaṃ kantissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc43:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc43:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī suttaṃ kanteyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc43:2.1.7: khomaṃ kappāsikaṃ koseyyaṃ kambalaṃ sāṇaṃ bhaṅgaṃ.
